Owned lifecycle source/prototype evidence is durable at [003af703f74fdfcd35bd62d4685bb8c1a69e60f8](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/003af703f74fdfcd35bd62d4685bb8c1a69e60f8/developer/swarm/20261011/successor-1955/report.md), actual298 remote files verified. Frozen7945 import-only probe (owned global path diversion only) records fchmodat(.../baseline/rcc-home,0750) and FAIL1 strict0700 guard; failed home is preserved0750. Source chain: HTFS init → private MakeSharedDir → missing-leaf parent recursion → existing configured home chmod. This is not proof of the same Actions cause.

Private Linux-only Go overlay exempts only the exact existing configured home parent when realdir/exact0700/currentUID+GID. Twelve controls pass; independent source review admits only owned new fixture comparisons. Actual new pack/gzip pipeline guards remain700 and file/lease outcomes pass. Explicit existing leaves, other existing home modes, ancestor/races and nonLinux remain unqualified; foreign-owner negative also fails mode. No tracked production source change, generic fix, guard waiver or historical timed-wave rerun. Details/strace/sourcepatch/independentreviews are hash-bound in the checkpoint. Ownership and broader #132 scope remain unchanged.
